title: PlayerTuning
description: Data-driven physics parameters for the player character

sprintMaxSpeed.description: Maximum horizontal speed while the sprint key is held (pixels/sec). A gap-width dial: jump reach is airtime x speed, and airtime is fixed by jumpVelocity and gravity, so this is the only number that changes how wide a gap can be crossed. At 160 a jump reaches 5.9 tiles; at 265 it reaches 9.8.

sprintAccel.description: Horizontal acceleration ABOVE the walking cap while sprint is held (pixels/sec²). Deliberately much lower than `accel`: it is what makes the top end something a committed hold builds toward (~0.75s) rather than something a tap grants. Below the walking cap `accel` still applies, so ordinary walking stays as responsive as ever.

sprintBlendPx.description: Width in pixels/sec of the band just above maxSpeed over which acceleration ramps from `accel` down to `sprintAccel`. Narrow on purpose: a ramp spread across the whole 160-265 range left acceleration near `accel` for the first stretch above the walking cap, which is most of what made a three-frame tap of the sprint key worth almost a full run. It also has to be a ramp rather than a step -- walking acceleration lands EXACTLY on maxSpeed, so a step there is decided by the last bit of a float and the two ports disagree.

sprintDecelPerSec.description: How fast the speed CAP falls back toward maxSpeed once sprint is released (pixels/sec per sec). The clamp follows the cap down, so speed bleeds off and the crow coasts. Zero snaps the cap instead, which reads as flying into a wall the instant a thumb lifts.

skidDecel.description: Deceleration applied when the movement input opposes current motion (pixels/sec²). Far harsher than `accel`, so turning around at speed costs a moment and reads as a skid -- which is what makes momentum feel like weight rather than like lag.

feel.description: Squash and stretch (brand/BRAND_SYSTEM.md §2.4). Read by player.gd only; PlayerMotion never sees it, so none of this can move the golden motion fixtures.

apexVy.description: |vy| below which the crow is at its apex and stops stretching (px/sec)

landSquashY.description: Vertical squash on the landing frame

landSquashX.description: Horizontal spread on the landing frame

shapeLerp.description: How fast the airborne shape eases toward its target (per second)
